# Fridge Contents Inventory

## Top Shelf
- **Butter lettuce/leaf lettuce** — 1-2 large heads — looks very fresh and crisp
- **Watermelon radish** — 1, halved — cut, should be used soon
- **Kohlrabi** — 1-2 heads — looks fresh
- **Red cabbage** — 1 half head — cut, use within a few days
- **White cabbage/napa cabbage** — partial head — fresh

## Second Shelf
- **Baby carrots/small carrots** — approximately 400-500g — fresh
- **Spinach/chard leaves** — large bunch, ~200-300g — fresh, use within 2-3 days
- **Broccoli** — 1 large head — fresh and green
- **Beetroot** — 1 medium — fresh

## Third Shelf
- **Feta cheese** — ~200-300g block — in container
- **Butter** — 1 standard block (~250g)
- **Tomato sauce/salsa** — 2 large jars — preserved
- **Small jar (sauce/extract)** — 1 small jar
- **Olives or preserved fruit** — 1 jar
- **Eggs** — approximately 6-8 eggs

## Bottom Shelf
- **Tomato preserves/passata** — 1 large jar
- **Fresh parsley** — 1 large bunch — fresh
- **Orange juice** — ~300-400ml in glass pitcher
- **Lemons** — 2-3 whole
